d: On the Lantern Festival in 619 AD, the world was peaceful and the people lived and worked in peace and contentment. Li Yuan has been ascended to the throne for half a year, and Li Jianye is appointed the prince. To this end, Li Yuan amnesty the world and celebrate with all the world.
A Ph.D. student finds herself unable to make new memories after a failed wormhole experiment.

The USS Essex is travelling in the furthest reaches of the known Universe when it encounters a gigantic creature. After pirates steal their cargo and most of their supplies the crew decide to capture the creature.

When a bullied young girl with a mentally unstable mother reaches her breaking point, she finds refuge in the company of an eccentric, wealthy bachelor who encourages her to believe in herself and find her own voice.
